buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Turnover

Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bids are invited through the GeM Portal from eligible, PESO-licensed bidders for the refilling and transporta tion of Hydrogen (H2) gas. The supplied Hydrogen gas must strictly comply with IS 1090 standards (Grade 2) (Annexure-A) required for critical meteorological sounding operations (PB/RS ascents). • Cylinder Ownership: All cylinders used under this contract are explicitly owned by the Buyer (Dep artment). • Turnkey Logistics: The successful bidder shall carry complete end-to-end responsibility for the saf e collection/pickup of empty departmental cylinders from the respective observatory premises, transit to their licensed refilling plant, loading/unloading, refilling, and returning the refilled cylinders safely ba ck to the originating station. 2. Scope of Work The contract operates as a Running Contract with Staggered Delivery over an initial period of one (1) year. The absolute scope of work includes: • Pickup & Safe Transit: Collection and transit of empty, buyer-owned Hydrogen cylinders from the three specified structural locations to the vendor’s licensed refilling facility. • Refilling: Refilling of departmental cylinders with Grade 2 Hydrogen gas (conforming strictly to IS 1 090) at an authorized, PESO-licensed plant. • Loading & Unloading: The bidder is fully responsible for arranging all necessary manpower and m echanisms required for loading and unloading cylinders at both the station collection points and the ref illing plant. • Pre-Dispatch Checks: The vendor must meticulously inspect valves on all cylinders for structural d efects or leakage prior to return dispatch. Any defective or leaking valves must be repaired or replace d by the vendor at their own cost. • Statutory Compliance: Strict and continuous adherence to all statutory, safety, and hazardous tra nsport guidelines prescribed by the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO) and relevant Central/State laws. Supply Mechanism & Quantity Tolerance

4.1 On-Demand / Staggered Delivery: Delivery shall be strictly staggered on an "as-and-when-require d" basis over the 365-day contract duration. 4.2 Quantity Variation Clause: The total contract quantity of 4,500 cu mt is an estimated baseline. The Buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the executed quantity during the contract period without any change in the accepted unit price or other terms and conditions. 4.3 Actual Consumption Billing: The Buyer shall only be financially liable to pay for the exact volume of gas successfully refilled, delivered, and certified via the Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CR AC) on GeM. The seller shall have absolutely no claim for idle charges, blocked capacity, or financial comp ensation if the actual total draw-out falls below the estimated baseline. 5. Technical Specifications The Hydrogen gas delivered under this framework must comply with the following structural parameters: • Standard / Certification: Fully compliant with the IS 1090 standard for filling Meteorological Balloo ns. • Gas Purity & Grade: Grade 2 / High Purity Hydrogen gas. (99.9%) • Impurities (CO2, CO, N2, H2O, THC): Strictly within maximum permissible limits as per official IS 1090 validation protocols. • Cylinder Handling: Refilling pressure must align with standard safe operational limits for the provid ed departmental cylinders. Proper hazardous substance labels and structural color-coding must be mai ntained during transit as per PESO norms. 6. Bidder Eligibility Criteria Bidders must upload valid, verifiable proofs for the following criteria during the technical evaluation phase. Failure to provide any of the following documents will result in immediate technical disqualification: • OEM: Must be an authorized manufacturer (OEM) of industrial gases. A valid PESO Licenc e is mandatory. This bid is strictly invited from Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) possessing their own licensed gas manufacturing/filling infrastructure and a valid PESO license issued in th e OEM’s legal name. Bids submitted by Resellers, Authorized Distributors, Agents, or Deale rs will be rejected outright during Technical Evaluation. OEM Self-Declaration • PESO Approval: Hold a valid, current, and active license/approval issued by the Petroleum and Expl osives Safety Organisation (PESO) for the storage, filling, and transportation of Compressed Hydrogen gas. · PESO HYDROTESTING LICENCE : Hold a valid, current license / approval from PESO for Hydrotest ing of cylinders. • Past Experience & GeM Track Record: The bidder must have successfully e xecuted at least three (3) similar contracts for the supply/refilling of Hydrogen gas or industrial gases to Government Organisations, Autonomous Bodies, Weather O bservatories, or PSUs within the past three (3) years. Out of these, at least one (1) contract m ust have been successfully executed and completed through the GeM Portal (Verifiable copy of the Ge M Contract Order along with its corresponding CRAC/Completion Certificate must be uploaded). · Bidder Annual Turnover must be (0-50%) of Estimated Bid Value : 13 lacs · Average Annual Turn Over Of OEM (In Lakhs) ( utpo 400%) : 50 lakhs · Documents to be submitted : CA Certificate with UDIN OR Audited P&L Statements. • Statutory Registrations: Possess a valid GST Registration Certificate and PAN Card. • MSME Benefit: Valid MSME/Udyam Certificate if claiming relaxation benefits in turnover or experien ce thresholds as permitted under automated GeM platform rules.

7. Financial Safeguards & Performance Security 7.1 Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Exempted. No physical or monetary EMD is required to participate i n this bid. In lieu of an upfront monetary deposit, all participating bidders must upload a signed and stamp ed Bid Security Declaration on their official company letterhead as per the standard format detailed under Annexure-B. 7.2 Performance Security (ePBG) Execution Details: The successful (L1) bidder must submit an Elect ronic Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG) for 5% of the total contract value within fifteen (15) days of the contract award on GeM. 7.3 Beneficiary Designation: The Bank Guarantee must be issued explicitly and verbatim in favor of: A SSISTANT METEOROLOGIST [ADMIN], IMD MUMBAI, PAYABLE AT MUMBAI. 7.4 Validity Period: The guarantee must remain active for a minimum duration of 14 months. 7.5 SFMS Routing: Bidders must instruct their issuing banking institution to digitally route the guarantee via the Structured Financial Messaging System (SFMS) to the Buyer’s designated advisory bank account to enable verification on the GeM portal. Any delay in contract execution arising from incorrect routing of the SFMS message shall rest solely with the vendor. 7.6 Applicable TDs 2% will be deducted from base amount of each billing instance. . Financial Evaluation & L1 Selection 8.1 GeM Evaluation Method: Qualified bidders will be Evaluated by GEM as per their system selection 8.2 GST Terms: The unit rates quoted by the bidder must be strictly exclusive of GST. The applicable GST percentage will be mapped on GeM and paid out on actual invoices. 8.3 L1 Determination: The contract will be awarded to the bidder who emerges as the lowest evaluated commercial responder for the respective clusters/locations and it will be system selected by GEM. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 8. Rate Contract Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they dont upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Rate Contract Tax and Duties Toll Tax/ Entry Tax/ Octroi Duty & Local Taxes. No separate payment would be made by the Buyer for Toll Taxes, Entry Taxes, Octroi duty and local Taxes, if any. The Seller should cater for these Taxes/ duties as part of Basic Rate quoted in the Bid. 10. Rate Contract OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion.

11. Rate Contract Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 12. Rate Contract NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 13. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 14. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 15. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 16. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): Petroleum and Explosive Safety organisation (PESO) License and PESO Hydrotesting License .
